pose: Side view of the dorsal column and ribcage. The ribs are long and curve deeply downward.
visual_hook: The 'Tall Heart'. The ribcage is narrow but very deep from top to bottom, making the T-Rex look powerful and athletic.
material: Matte, toasted-tan bone. The backbone has high, rugged spines (neural spines).
inset_view: Top-right corner: Cross-section of a rib showing the 'I-beam' shape—thin but incredibly strong.
